G1: no record states it closed; not claimed. Publication stays owed: no private/baselines/556460e31 on this host.

ledger.title: A NULL Safe resting on an unvalidated declaration through a callee summary does not publish that declaration
ledger.text: PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION, held row: librdkafka rdkafka_mock_cgrp.c rd_kafka_mock_cgrp_consumer_member_needs_assignment goes NULL Unknown -> Safe between 2c07390b6 and 9aed1913a on corpus and twelve-home; its new proof at :1218 is result:summary:rd_kafka_mock_cgrp_consumer_member_target_assignment_assignable, whose returns_non_null comes from rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new (:1075), declared non-null by RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS and not validated (RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-CONSTRUCTORS-UNVALIDATED). A direct use publishes `declared:rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new: a non-null result (resource contract)` (unittest_list_to_map); neither the callee's nor this caller's NULL record lists it (assumptions only `inferred ... #member`, no dependency on _list_new). DISCHARGE: carry a summary's declared-result assumptions into every row that uses the summary (and into the summary's own record), with a fixture and Lean parity, then re-measure; or show the assumption is published elsewhere in the row's verdict tuple. Until then the row's NULL Safe is held and not counted as accepted.

ledger.title: sb_remove_chunk_from_segregated_backlog is provisional Unsafe on a destroy == 0 path no call supplies
ledger.text: PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION: fluent-bit-system plugins/in_storage_backlog/sb.c sb_remove_chunk_from_segregated_backlog (and its unit) moved Unknown -> Unsafe in NULLABLE-GUARDED-RELEASE's landing (system 114/0/330/4 at 38cf960fa, 114/0/329/5 at 1f2007667; that card's commits are the only code between): rule 74c reads `&chunk->_head` as an address inside *chunk, so the wrapper unlinked by mk_list_del (sb.c:226, resource_unpublished) stays tracked, and the `if (destroy)` false arm exits with it live (leak acquired at :226). The function is static and its only call (sb_remove_chunk_from_segregated_backlogs, sb.c:258) passes FLB_TRUE, so the violation is not reachable in the program: a function-scope verdict over an unconstrained formal. It sits on the chunk-lifecycle path later cards build on. DISCHARGE: decide the row under its callers' actuals (a caller-constrained formal, or the static function analysed at its call sites), or record the scope in the verdict so it is not read as a program defect; never present it as an upstream defect.

ledger.title: Provisional Unsafe librdkafka unit tests leak only on their own assertion-failure returns
ledger.text: PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION: librdkafka rdunittest_acknowledge.c ut_case_acknowledge_accept and ut_case_acknowledge_multiple_partitions (AG1-INDIRECT-MEMBER-ACCESS, between 556460e31 and 2c07390b6) and rdkafka_sticky_assignor.c ut_testSameSubscriptions (RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS, between 2c07390b6 and 9aed1913a), with their units, are Unsafe on leaks at RD_UT_ASSERT / verifyValidityAndBalance early returns before the test's destroy call. Each failing condition calls an uncontracted function (ut_ack_get_type, verifyValidityAndBalance0), so the path's feasibility is not validated: it is taken only when the test itself fails. Not a validated reachable violation; not an upstream defect. DISCHARGE: validate the failing branch's feasibility (contract or body of the condition's callee) or classify assertion-failure exits of test code as out of the reported scope, with a fixture; re-measure the three rows.

ledger.title: Evidence-only row changes since 556460e31 that no record, introduced text, declaration or card note attributes
ledger.text: PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION classified every evidence-only change of its chain over the priority0 sides (scripts/evidence_classes.py, artifacts/evidence-classes.json.gz): 495 row-steps (corpus 197, twelve-home 197, system 60, slice 41; 432 of them in common->tip) are tied to no committed pinned landing record, no declaration, atom or leaf text introduced in the step, no summary cascade and no card note. They are mostly removals of generic leaves (unresolved resource identity, indirect memory access) and NULL-premise id changes; no verdict moves with them. Their causes lie in the landings after 2c07390b6 that did not measure the pinned routes (r41-r73 except the SP cards). DISCHARGE: a pinned-route measurement of each such landing (or of each gap between committed records), committed with its rows, which attributes each listed row-step or names it as a cross-card interaction.

ledger.title: No record states REEVALUATION_SPEC §9's G1 (certificate containment) closed
ledger.text: PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION searched the specification, status, matrix and reports: the 2026-09-05 six-finding repair in docs/REEVALUATION_SPEC.md records the WM01-WM03 and VP01-VP02 fixes, and every landing gate runs reevaluation_probe with exit 0 (failed_expectations 0), but no record evaluates G1's 'explicit profile restrictions' deliverable or its criterion (invalid candidates and insufficient evidence cannot obtain the affected certificates; positive controls survive) and declares the gate met; the spec lists capability-specific witnesses and third-party Unsafe witness validation as open. G1 is not claimed. DISCHARGE: a closure record against §9's deliverable and criterion (the probes, the profile restrictions in force and the open items it excludes), or a statement that G1 remains open with what is missing.

ledger.title: measure chain --declared refuses a PREDICTION.md with two measure-prediction blocks
ledger.text: Found by PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION with QUIRIN-AUDIT-CONNECT abc7ce7ad: `--declared` reads exactly one block (`2 measure-prediction blocks; exactly one is read`), and two committed predictions carry two: cg10-indirect-access-sole-residuals-r3 (a revision) and member-effect-stores (a block written after its landing measurement, 'for the record only'). The card split them by hand (docs/reports/priority0-remeasurement/chain/predictions/). Also observed: a unit row attributed by derivation carries no source label (`derived_from_function_rows` only), and a four-route --runs chain peaked at 1.7 GiB resident against the short lane's 1 GiB admission budget. DISCHARGE: a stated rule for several blocks (the last before the implementation commit, or every block marked as a revision), a label on derived attributions, and a slot class or budget for chains.

ledger.title: Records that do not join a chain are unused, so cancellations inside a step stay invisible
ledger.text: Found by PRIORITY0-ATTRIBUTION: landing records measured at other bases and binaries never join (refused revision, analyzer, build commit), so a chain over the sides sees no move that cancels inside a step. Two did (mk_sched_threads_purge and mk_sched_threads_destroy_all: Unknown -> Safe in LIST-ENTRY-RELEASE-IDENTITY, back in RULE50-CONSUMER-COMPOSITION's landing); they were found by placing the 23 records with equal inputs on main's first-parent line and reading their side figures (docs/reports/priority0-remeasurement/scripts/landing_records.py). DISCHARGE: accept non-joining records with equal inputs as figure and row checkpoints inside a step, listing every row a checkpoint shows at a verdict the step's ends do not.
